construct: Loss-of-function SCN5A variants reduce availability of the cardiac Nav1.5 fast sodium current. Reduced inward sodium current impairs rapid phase-0 depolarization and conduction, contributing to characteristic right-precordial ST-segment patterns and vulnerability to ventricular fibrillation.

adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Fever-associated syncope, coved ST elevation in V1-V3, family nocturnal sudden death, and SCN5A loss identify Brugada syndrome from reduced Nav1.5 fast inward sodium current and impaired phase-0 conduction.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: LQT3 involves increased persistent late sodium current, LQT2 reduced IKr, CPVT RyR2 calcium leak, and HCN channels pacemaker current. SCN5A Brugada loss-of-function uniquely reduces the fast phase-0 sodium current.
